mission.title: Silence Speaks Louder
mission.description: Plant a bug on the smugglers' mainframe and recover the first device component.

npc.say: Ah, {player}. I have a matter I would like to discuss with you. There have been some... troubling sightings recently. Black helicopters have been seen over the City. Their presence is unexplained. We are monitoring the situation. Some awakened humans believe that the helicopters are connected to Neo somehow. That he has been... resurrected. This counterproductive fascination with death intrigues us. Remain alert, {player}.

Listen, the guys who took the component, they were kinda... creepy, if you know what I mean. I'd be careful if I were you. And don't forget to put in a good word, okay? I could use a break from all the pressure those damn Agents have been pilin' on me.

phase.briefing: The data you obtained for us regarding the device has been very... informative. We now have a list of component pieces that will be necessary to construct our own prototype. The first piece is in the possession of a certain group of smugglers. We have a great interest in tracking the actions of this group; you will obtain a bug from one of our Agents before proceeding to the target location.

enter.say: You'll find Agent North in this area. He has the bug for you.

objective.text: Get the bug from Agent North

talk.say: {player}. I believe you are here for this.

done.say: That's the bug. You can head out of there now.

phase.briefing: You may now proceed to the location of the smugglers in question. Once there, you will plant the bug on their mainframe. You will also locate and secure the device component. It is important that you avoid any conflict or interaction with the Exiles. A low profile will be necessary to avoid rousing any undue... suspicion on their part.

enter.say: This is the place, {player}. Make sure you don't start any fights in there!

objective.text: Plant the bug on the mainframe

done.say: Great work, the bug's in place.
Our data indicates that the device component is in a desk in this room.
Empty. This was not predicted by our data. You must locate any evidence indicating the component's current location.

talk.say: You're with who? Ah, crap... Listen, I'll do you a favor if you put in a good word with the Machines, okay? These guys showed up earlier today and snagged the component. I don't know who they were, I don't know what they were doing with it... but they were willing to pay for it, so hey, right? Here, you can have the disk they gave me in payment. Just remember me to your boss, eh?

done.say: I think that disk is the best evidence you'll be able to find here. You'd better upload it at a hardline once you're finished.
Hm. The code signature of that disk is strange somehow.

objective.text: Upload the disk at a hardline

phase.briefing: I am receiving the data from that disk as we speak. Very... interesting. Our scans indicate that the contents of this disk were downloaded from the Merovingian's network. The Merovingian's closest network hardpoint is nearby. I am sending you the coordinates now, {player}. Proceed there and search for the component.

enter.say: I hope this is the right spot! I'm beginning the area scan for the component now...
Okay, the scan's complete. The device is in a safe in that room.

objective.text: Get the device component from the safe

done.say: That's the component! Now get out of there.

phase.briefing: This continued Exile meddling is... troubling. We will be looking into this situation in the near future. Now, however, Agent North is waiting for you at a new location; take the device component to him.

objective.text: Give the device component to Agent North

talk.say: I believe you have something for me, {player}.

done.say: That's it. You can get out of there now.

mission.finish: Contact me when you are prepared for another task, {player}. More components of the device remain to be gathered.
